heading: Evaluation
lead: The Commissioner shall, through grants or contracts awarded or entered into with independent auditors, conduct evaluations and related activities, of family resource and support programs, including—

tree.text: process evaluations focusing on implementation strategies; and
the development of simple evaluation models for use by local family resource and support programs.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 1, 1990, see section 1001(a) of Pub. L. 101–501, set out as an Effective Date of 1990 Amendment note under section 8621 of this title.
